# Particulars of claim: interpreter fees

The claimant, ⟦PERSON|Надир Оскарович Ветлин⟧, seeks GBP 460 from ⟦ORG|Amber Quay Translations Ltd⟧ for two interpreting assignments. The defendant accepted the booking by email but disputes whether the second session exceeded the original time allowance. The claimant relies on the attendance sheet and the recorded extension request.

1. The first session ended within the agreed period. Its fee is admitted and remains unpaid solely because the defendant placed both invoices on hold.
2. During the second session, the defendant's coordinator requested an additional hour. The claimant accepted that request after explaining that the hourly rate would continue to apply.
3. The defendant received the signed attendance sheet the next morning. No objection to its accuracy was raised until payment became overdue.

The bilingual exhibit identifies the claimant as follows: «Заявитель: ⟦PERSON|Ветлин Н. О.⟧. Объяснения ⟦PERSON|Ветлина⟧ прилагаются». Those expressions refer to the same interpreter. A later note reads «⟦PERSON|Надир Оскарович⟧ подтвердил время» and records the extended finish time.

The claimant requests the unpaid fee, the filing fee and interest at the contractual rate. No separate damages are sought for inconvenience. The claimant asks that any hearing be listed in Manchester.

Statement of truth: I believe the facts stated here are true.

Signed: ⟦PERSON|Надир Оскарович Ветлин⟧, claimant.
